Engagement with open data can be measured through:

- Articles, tools, and research that reference open data

- Attendance at events

- Communications and questions about data

- Public information requests for new data

## Articles

The potential for journalists and researchers to act as intermediaries of open data by synthesizing open data into useful information [@shaharudin2023] and creating feedback loops to government [@wilson2019].

### Measures

Article measures include publication, date, topic, department data owners, links to data, and contributions made by the publication staff of new data, visualizations, and tools created in support of the article. The presence of articles demonstrates accessibility of department data for local reporting and public interest.

View methods for tracking and reporting on [articles](articles.qmd).

Events and attendance.
